titles.title: SCREEN Act of 2026
SCREEN Act of 2026
Strengthened Checks for Reliable Evaluation of Entrants Nationwide Act of 2026
A bill to add the Department of State and the Department of Homeland Security to the list of permitted disclosures for the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
